pages.raw_meta: Emergent BioSolutions provides specialty products for civilian and military populations that address intentional and naturally emerging public health threats.
raw_blocks: Countermeasures season 4 is out now - follow along as we look back at public health crises and bioterrorism events throughout history.
Who we protect will not change, but how we protect them will. Emergent is leading the new way forward for public health.
We are a leading public health company that delivers protective and life-saving solutions to communities a round the world.
We offer commercialized products that address endemic public health threats such as the opioid epidemic.
We specialize in developing, manufacturing, and supplying medical countermeasures for national security and public health preparedness .
We leverage our specialized in-house capabilities to support biopharma innovators, governments and non-government organizations with their development and manufacturing needs. ​
At Emergent, our mission is to protect and save lives.

pages.raw_meta: At Emergent, our mission is to protect and save lives. For over 25 years, we’ve been at work preparing those entrusted with protecting public health. We deliver protective and life-saving solutions for health threats like smallpox, mpox, botulism, Ebola, anthrax and opioid overdose emergencies.
raw_blocks: At Emergent, our mission is to protect and save lives. For over 25 years, we’ve been at work preparing those entrusted with protecting public health. We deliver protective and life-saving solutions for health threats like smallpox, mpox, botulism, Ebola, anthrax and opioid overdose emergencies. We help prepare communities for today’s health challenges and tomorrow’s threats by:
Empowering the public with the resources to respond to an opioid overdose emergency
Delivering medical countermeasures to fight critical, even deadly, biological threats
Stepping up to help address emerging and infectious diseases
Emergent opened for business, partnering with the U.S. government to supply BioThrax (Anthrax Vaccine Absorbed) for military members.
Terror attacks and subsequent anthrax letter incidents call for increased production of BioThrax, the only FDA-licensed anthrax vaccine at the time.
Began development of CYFENDUS® (Anthrax Vaccine Absorbed, Adjuvanted), previously known as AV7909.
Acquired first Maryland-based site in Gaithersburg.
Emergent BioSolutions common stock begins trading on the New York Stock Exchange ($EBS).
Received first multi-year contract for BioThrax (Anthrax Vaccine Absorbed) by the U.S. government.

Received funding for CYFENDUS® (Anthrax Vaccine Absorbed, Adjuvanted) from the Biomedical Advanced Research and Development Authority (BARDA) and National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases (NIAID).
Acquired a manufacturing facility in Baltimore’s Bayview neighborhood.
Initiated Phase 1 study for CYFENDUS® (Anthrax Vaccine Absorbed, Adjuvanted).
Acquired Cangene Corporation, broadening Emergent’s portfolio of government-procured countermeasures.
Acquired rights to auto-injector technology, growing our devices business.
Acquired ACAM2000®, (Smallpox (Vaccinia) Vaccine, Live) and raxibacumab (a fully human monoclonal antibody).
Acquired NARCAN® Nasal Spray (naloxone HCl).
Acquired TEMBEXA® (brincidofovir) and announced collaboration with Ridgeback Therapeutics to expand availability of EbangaTM (Ansuvimab-zykl).
Received approval for over-the-counter designation for NARCAN® Nasal Spray; received U.S. FDA approval of CYFENDUS® (Anthrax Vaccine Adsorbed, Adjuvanted).
Obtained commercial rights to KLOXXADO® (naloxone HCI) Nasal Spray 8 mg

Our culture is informed by our values and commitment to protecting and saving lives. For all the people touched by our work, we operate with an unwavering commitment to honesty, integrity, and quality.

raw_blocks: We develop, manufacture, and deliver protective and life-saving solutions for communities around the world.

Emergent distributes NARCAN® Nasal Spray 4 mg and KLOXXADO® (naloxone HCI) Nasal Spray 8 mg to federal and state leaders, community-based organizations, harm reduction groups, law enforcement and first responders through its expansive distribution network.
NARCAN® Nasal Spray is also widely available nationwide as the first FDA-approved, over-the-counter (OTC) 4 mg naloxone product for the emergency treatment of opioid overdose.
NARCAN ® Nasal Spray 4 mg
KLOXXADO ®* Nasal Spray 8 mg
